newsitem.title: POLAND: National Express to sell Polish unit - paper.
newsitem.headline: National Express to sell Polish unit - paper.

text.p: The British coach and rail group Naional Express will sell its loss-making Polish subsidiary Polski Express, newspapers reported on Friday.
Nowa Europa economic daily quoted National Express' financial director Colin Child as saying that his company would sell the Polish subsidiary to a domestic firm or just sell its coaches.
Child said Polski Express' bad financial situation resulted mainly from the Polish government's subsidies for the state-owned coach company PKS, but could also stem from bad management.
Polski Express, set up in 1994 operating on five main routes in Poland with 23 coaches, brought a loss of $750,000 last year, Nowa Europa reported.
